reviewers.summary: The latest changes add assertions but leave the previously reported guided-path and App-integration test gaps unresolved.

findingList.message: The guided checklist still omits the required role-specific working views, including technical findings, finance reserve, and legal obligations.

evidence.codePathTraced: getPresenterGuidedChecklist returns the same routes for every persona. Its Case link targets /overview, while the technical findings, finance reserve, and legal obligations paths are not used.
evidence.failureScenario: A presenter switches to finance or legal and follows the Case link; it opens the generic overview instead of the required role-specific working view.

findingList.message: The named reset test still does not verify the App-level scope check or the reset command's CSRF and revision safeguards.

evidence.codePathTraced: presenter_scoped_reset_actions renders PresenterDemoControl with a mock callback and checks only that the callback receives a case ID. It does not exercise App.tsx or submitHangarCaseReset.
evidence.failureScenario: If App.tsx stops checking presenter case scope or submitting the existing reset command with CSRF and revision safeguards, this test still passes.

findingList.message: The named View as test still does not verify the production switch-user request, CSRF, success-gated navigation, or rejection behavior.

evidence.codePathTraced: AC_004_presenter_view_as_contract passes a mock onViewAs callback and asserts persona IDs; it does not exercise App.tsx's role-switch request or navigation.
evidence.failureScenario: If App.tsx omits CSRF, navigates before the server succeeds, or fails to preserve the session after rejection, this test still passes.
